name: Blended lightly-aged rum
description: A blended rum given only a short rest in oak — long enough to soften the spirit and pick up a pale gold tint, not long enough to take on heavy wood. Usually filtered light so it mixes like a white rum with more body. The workhorse base of mid-weight tiki drinks like the Test Pilot and Fog Cutter; Banks 5 Island and Denizen Aged White are go-to bottles.
